description_en: Creates multiple firewall rules for a simple application server at a time
description_zh: 为指定的轻量应用服务器批量创建防火墙规则
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-firewall-rules --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFirewallRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询轻量应用服务器的可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The port number.

When the transport layer protocol is TCP and/or UDP, the port number range is 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<Start port number>/\<End port number>. Example: 1/200.

When the transport layer protocol is ICMP, the port number range is -1/-1, which indicates all ports
fields.help_zh:
端口号。
TCP/UDP：取值范围为 1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
ICMP：-1/-1
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The description of the firewall rule
fields.name: remark

fields.help_en:
The transport layer protocol. Valid values:

TCP

UDP

TCP+UDP

ICMP
fields.help_zh:
传输层协议。可能值：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议。
ICMP: ICMP协议
fields.name: rule_protocol

fields.help_en: The IP address or CIDR block that is allowed in the firewall rule
fields.name: source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_zh: 由防火墙规则信息组成的数组
parameters.name: firewall_rules

fields.help_en:
The tag key. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://. The tag key cannot start with acs: or aliyun
fields.help_zh:
为防火墙规则指定的标签键。N 的取值范围：1~20

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 64 个字符，不能以 aliyun 和 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh:
为防火墙规则指定的标签值。N 的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 64 个字符，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags that you want to add to the firewall. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

FirewallRuleIds.description_en: The IDs of the firewall rules that you created

items.description_en: The ID of the firewall rule that you created
